agent.userMessage: What approvals are still pending on the Henderson project?
agent.agentResponse: Based on your email threads with the Hendersons, two items are still pending approval: the master bath vanity (you sent the Restoration Hardware options on Tuesday) and the living room drapery fabric (samples were delivered last week). Karen also asked about paint sheen for the dining room but hasn't responded to your recommendation yet. Want me to draft a follow-up?
agent.followUp: Draft a gentle follow-up to Karen about the vanity and fabric selections
agent.followUpResponse: Done! I drafted a follow-up to Karen checking in on the vanity and drapery selections, mentioning the vanity has a 6-week lead time so a decision soon would keep the project on schedule. Ready to review and send.

verticalFaqs.question: I juggle 8-10 projects at once. Can Duet keep them straight?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet tracks every email thread per client and project. When you ask about the Henderson kitchen or the Park Avenue office, it pulls context from all related conversations — vendor orders, contractor updates, client approvals — so your replies are always accurate and project-specific. No mixing up which tile was for which client.

verticalFaqs.question: I coordinate with a lot of contractors and vendors. Does Duet help with that?
verticalFaqs.answer: Absolutely. Duet learns your contractor contacts, vendor reps, and the context of each trade's role in your projects. When your electrician emails that rough-in is done, Duet can draft a reply confirming the next step or loop in the fixture installer. It keeps the workflow moving even when you're across town at another job site.
